producer_report.summary: Added the athena-core `divergence` module. `reconcile(claims, observations)` returns a `Divergence` finding (Mismatch, Unobserved or Undocumented) for every disagreement and drops none. OLY-B-S3-02 in docs/spec.toml now names it as its mechanism, with a measure ending `status: not shown`. The new `tests/divergence.rs` covers each kind and checks the spec entry. I also added a CHANGELOG entry and a shard-timings line for the new test file.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry id = "OLY-B-S3-02" no longer has mechanism = "none"; its mechanism names crates/athena-core/src/divergence.rs and the reconcile function, owner stays "Athena", and measure names crates/athena-core/tests/divergence.rs and ends with `status: not shown`.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited the entry; spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism in tests/divergence.rs asserts each part and passes.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/divergence.rs exists, is declared in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs with a doc bullet, and defines Divergence findings of three kinds (mismatch, unobserved claim, undocumented observation) returned by a reconcile function.
criteria_check.evidence: File created; `pub mod divergence;` and a [`divergence`] doc bullet in lib.rs; enum Divergence has Mismatch, Unobserved, Undocumented; reconcile returns Vec<Divergence>.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test divergence`: reconcile on matching input gives no findings, and on a differing value, a claim with no observation, and an observation with no claim gives exactly one finding of the matching kind each, none dropped. The test cannot compile or pass without the module.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test -p athena-core --test divergence: 6 passed, including matching, mismatch, unobserved, undocumented, and combined tests.

criteria_check.criterion: The same test file has a spec test that reads docs/spec.toml and fails while OLY-B-S3-02 has mechanism = "none" (run via cargo test -p athena-core --test divergence).
criteria_check.evidence: spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism asserts the entry lacks mechanism = "none"; passes in the run above.
left to Athena's checks (I ran cargo fmt --all).

criteria_check.criterion: cargo clippy --all-targets passes with no warnings.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks (I ran it with -D warnings, clean).

criteria_check.criterion: cargo test passes for the workspace.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks; targeted divergence, policy and mirrors tests pass.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry recording OLY-B-S3-02's mechanism, its test name and that its measure ends `status: not shown`.
criteria_check.evidence: New first bullet under Unreleased/Added names reconcile, the test file, spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism, and status: not shown.

learnings: A new test file needs a line in xtask/shard-timings.txt (the mirrors test covers it).
